item.title: eml_parser vulnerable to DoS via deeply nested parens in Received headers
item.description: Score 61/100 MEDIUM — CVSS 7.5 — ### Summary `eml_parser` strips parenthesised CFWS comments from `Received:` headers using a regex-based fix-point loop. The loop has quadratic time complexity in the number of nested parens. A single `Received:` header containing 5,000 nested parens causes ~1.3 seconds of CPU saturation per parsed . Full analysis, Sigma/YARA rules, IOCs, Attack Chain by CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX v4.0.
